sections.title: Morning Shift (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Both chargers for bodycam gone missing.
Morning shift deployed. Commencing patrol towards Aotea Square, with welfare checks on businesses along the way.
Queen Street Starbucks, Localito, McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Heading up to Skytower via Wellesley Street and Federal Street.
Skytower area, 77 Convenience Store and cafe all clear. Standing by to show presence. A few vagrants spotted at the corner of Federal Street near the mobile shop.
St Patrick Cathedral Church all clear, no issues to report.
Albert Mart Convenience Store all clear, no issues to report.
Bus Interchange Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues to report.
Commercial Bay full sweep around Reign and Pour and surrounds all clear. TK Square all clear. Standing by for calls.
Commencing full Queen Street sweep towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Auckland Library sweep all clear, no issues to report.
Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report.
High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Chancery Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Heading on Queen Street towards Britomart.
Fort Lane, Gore Street, Wilson Carpark and surrounds all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Customs Street all clear, no issues to report.
TK Square all clear. Standing by for calls. Welfare check for McDonald's Britomart all clear.
Heading to Aotea Square via High Street and Lorne Street.
High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall check all clear, no issues to report.
Chancery Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report.
Heading to Aotea Square via Victoria and Queen Street.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Received a call from Tatty's Recycle Boutique about a person stealing from the store. Heading there now.

At Tatty's and discussed with the manager. Got the photos; POI headed towards Chancery Square. Guards looked for her but no luck around Chancery. Received a call from Ahmad to let him into the office. Heading to HQ.
At HQ. Let Ahmad in; will continue patrol shortly.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street, Localito, Footlocker and Unichem, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for lunch break.
At HQ having lunch break and standing by for calls.
Standing by at HQ for shift handover and calls.
Morning shift completed, all clear, no issues to report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 20:46)
items: Equipment handover: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. Both chargers for bodycam gone missing.
Ops phone charging as battery is at 8%. Standing by at office for calls.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Aotea Square. Welfare check on McDonald's Queen Street, Footlocker and Localito all clear, no issues.
Aotea Square full sweep all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Britomart.
Full sweep Queen Street completed, no issues to report. TK Square all clear.
Commercial Bay all clear, no issues to report. Areas around Commercial Bay also clear including the bus interchange. Standing by at TK Square for calls.
Customs Street sweep all clear, no issues to report.
Wilson Carpark and Gore Street all clear, no issues to report. Fort Lane all clear.
High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall check all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Chancery Square all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Received a call from McDonald's Queen Street about a vagrant sitting outside on the side asking for food from customers. Heading there now.
High Street all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. The vagrant was sitting outside on public property and was not causing any issues. Informed the restaurant manager about this.
Darby Street all clear, no issues to report.
Elliott Stables and Jungle 8 welfare check all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for calls.
Heading to HQ as one guard signs off at 19:30.
At HQ standing by for calls.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:44 – 06:30)
items: Standing by at Reign n Pour until second guard shows up.
Welfare check Mothership all clear, no issues.
Standing by at McDonald's Queen Street until guard shows up.
Leaving McDonald's Queen Street as guard has arrived. Commencing patrol.

Received a call from QF Tavern about a female wearing a white fur coat, black denim pants and a bucket hat, being aggressive toward staff and slamming doors. Guards informed staff to contact Police and send a photo of her so they can keep an eye out in case she tries to cause trouble at other venues.
Standing by at Bar101. Group of delinquents intoxicated and causing trouble with other patrons.
Confiscated a bottle of Alize off a male delinquent. Tipped out the alcohol that was in it.
A couple of patrons arguing with each other and becoming aggressive. Managed to de-escalate the situation.
One intoxicated patron kept bothering the hotdog guy, which nearly caused a fight. Guards moved him away and stood close to the hotdog stand to ensure no trouble.
Final sweeps outside Bar101. Standing by showing presence in case of any fights.
Received a call from Victoria Street 77 Convenience, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham Street, past QF Tavern, showing presence to ensure no fights break out.
Patrolling past Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Chancery Square and Freyberg Place all clear, no issues.
Heading back to HQ to prepare for shift handover.
